ios.desc:
overthere is a simple parking app that uses photos to remember where you parked. a visual memory for your parking spot.
--
features:
• snap & save – take a photo of your parking spot and save the details instantly.
• widgets – add widgets to your home screen and lockscreen to see your parking info at a glance without opening up the app.
• auto delete – we help you delete images after 7 days.
• smart reminders – set a timer and get notified before your parking expires.
• location pin – automatically saves your parking location so you can walk back stress-free.
• multiple photos – capture different views of your parking spot.
• add notes – add context to find your spot easily.
• easy sharing – send your parking location to friends or family in seconds.
• 100% private – all data stays on your device.

park smarter, not harder.
